title: Intelinside result
description: One benchmark result, committed as results/<your-github-handle>/<name>.json. Ids come from the hardware, model, quant, and runtime catalog in frontend/src/catalog/. The pull request check validates the ids; this schema covers the shape.

rig.description: The number at the end of your rig's URL on the site, or the rig's exact name. The rig must be yours.

component.description: Hardware id of the one part the run used, for example intel-arc-b580. Leave out for a whole-rig result.

componentQuantity.description: How many of that part were used. Needs component.

quant.description: Quant id, for example int4 or q4_k_m. Must be one the model has a board for.

runtime.description: Runtime id, for example llamacpp, cascadia, openvino-genai.

decodeTps.description: Decode tokens per second. This is what ranks.

ttftMs.description: Time to first token, in milliseconds.

result.description: The result's URL on the site once submitted. Added when the file is written from a result page.
